$comment: Curated intake for Transformer Tenders. build-tenders.js merges this file into data/tenders.json. Add a row only after the official portal is checked. See docs/tender-intake.md. Do not commit bid PDFs.

notices.title: CPRI Bengaluru automated transformer test bench
notices.summary: Central Power Research Institute in Bengaluru has an open GeM bid for one automated no-load, load-loss and temperature-rise test bench. The BidPlus notice is GEM/2026/B/8212405, dated 5 November 2026, and the bid end on that notice is 28 November 2026 at 11:00 India time. Delivery on the notice is to the CPRI office at Sadashivanagar, Bengaluru.

notices.title: POWERGRID Eastern Region-II CT analyzers
notices.buyer: Power Grid Corporation of India Limited
notices.summary: Power Grid Corporation of India Limited has a bid for two current-transformer analyzers for Eastern Region-II. Bid GEM/2026/B/8222695 is dated 12 November 2026 and the bid end on the published notice is 27 November 2026 at 11:00 India time. The notice splits the two units between the Alipurduar HVDC station and the Berhampore switching station. POWERGRID published that bid on its own tender host.

notices.title: GSECL Sikka power transformer test kit
notices.summary: Gujarat State Electricity Corporation Limited has an open GeM bid for one 3-phase multi-function power transformer test kit for the Sikka thermal station. Bid GEM/2026/B/8235664 is dated 6 November 2026 and the bid end on the BidPlus notice is 27 November 2026 at 15:00 India time. The consignee address on the notice is Sikka Thermal Power Station, Jamnagar, and the quantity is one.

notices.title: India: POWERGRID tenders 11 single-phase 500 MVA transformers (package 7TR-25-BULK)
notices.buyer: Power Grid Corporation of India Limited
notices.summary: POWERGRID published package 7TR-25-BULK on 23 November 2026 with RFx 5002005859. The notice calls for 11 single-phase transformers rated 500 MVA each at 765/400 kV. Bids are due 23 December 2026 at 11:00 IST. This is a separate solicitation, not an award.

notices.title: India: POWERGRID tenders 13 single-phase 500 MVA transformers (package 7TR-22-BULK)
notices.buyer: Power Grid Corporation of India Limited
notices.summary: POWERGRID published package 7TR-22-BULK on 23 November 2026 with RFx 5002005535. The notice calls for 13 single-phase transformers rated 500 MVA each at 765/400/33 kV. Bids are due 23 December 2026 at 11:00 IST. This is a separate solicitation, not an award.

notices.title: Germany: Kassel utility seeks suppliers for medium-voltage transformer framework
notices.summary: TED contract notice 811438-2026, published 23 November 2026, invites requests to participate in a medium-voltage transformer supply framework in Kassel. Requests are due 21 December 2026 at 10:00 CET. The oil-filled 12 kV or 24 kV transformer references are qualification criteria, not confirmed order ratings. No award or purchase quantity is stated.

notices.title: FMV tenders 65/16.5 kV transformers for the new Ernen substation
notices.summary: FMV is seeking one power transformer for Ernen, rated 25 MVA ONAN and at least 32 MVA ONAF, with an identical second unit optional. TED amendment 811631-2026 gives a revised deadline of 14 December at 23:59 CET. No award is reported.

notices.title: Poland: PSE moves stage IX transformer renewal Package III deadline to 11 December
notices.summary: TED amendment 813139-2026, published 23 November 2026, moves the Package III offer deadline for PSE’s stage IX transformer renewal to 11 December 2026 at 12:00 CET. The original notice gave 30 November. The sites are Jarosław Systemowa, Miękinia, Gdańsk Błonia and Ołtarzew. The other five packages have separate deadlines.

notices.title: Switzerland: Groupe E seeks three 23 MVA transformers for Hauterive
notices.summary: Groupe E is inviting bids for three 23 MVA power transformers for the Hauterive hydroelectric site in Fribourg. The scope includes design, manufacture, factory tests, delivery, erection supervision, commissioning and spares. Bids close 1 February 2027 at 12:00 CET. The notice does not identify a supplier.

notices.title: Západoslovenská distribučná and Východoslovenská distribučná tender 110/23 kV three-phase oil power transformers
notices.summary: The joint framework seeks three-phase oil-filled 110/23 kV power transformers. The 25 November amendment confirms bids close on 4 December 2026 at 10:00 CET. The notice estimates EUR 37,800,000; it does not report an award.

notices.title: Slovenia: Mrzla Rupa hydro transformer and MV block bids now due 9 December
notices.summary: Addendum 1 extends bidding for the Mrzla Rupa small hydropower rehabilitation to 9 December 2026 at 10:00 CET and requires bidders to use the revised forms. Lot 2 is for the transformer and medium-voltage block; Lot 1 is for generating equipment. Transformer rating and award are not stated in the notice.

notices.title: Brazil: São Sebastião port tenders a 750 kVA dry-type transformer
notices.summary: Companhia Docas de São Sebastião seeks supply and installation of one 750 kVA dry-type transformer for port substation 04. The buyer’s specification is 13.8 kV to 220/127 V with IP23 mechanical protection; the national procurement portal lists the submission cutoff as 1 December at 09:00 Brasília time.
